description: This Kotlin class manages temporary user identity, specifically storing and retrieving the user's email used for cart persistence, utilizing Android's SharedPreferences for storage.

classes.name: CartIdentityStore
classes.description: A class for storing and retrieving the user's email identity for cart persistence purposes.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the stored email used for cart ownership, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Stores the provided email for cart ownership. Passing null clears the stored email.
